cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Why I missed our anniversary dinner belongs in the calendar review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're having the replacement dinner now. Explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. This booking covers dinner, not the review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll cancel dessert and we can talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need to resolve the cancellation before opening a second complaint.

mechanism: A copies a folded menu as a formal session cue and covers by classifying intimate questions into separate reviews and complaints.
confusable: D182 redirects dangerous questions by scope; D171 controls how an apology must be delivered.
comparison: Repair meeting versus a shared anniversary meal and cancelled dessert.
seedUse: Keep B practical willingness to drop dessert as the next process A hides behind.
